weeks.title: Week 1: Derivative Basics
weeks.lessonHtml:
Week 1: Derivative Basics

Learning Objectives

  • Identify instruments that qualify as derivatives
  • Measure derivatives at fair value each period
  • Recognize unrealized gains/losses in P&L (default treatment)

Key Topics

1. Definition of derivative

This topic covers essential CPA exam concepts related to Definition of derivative. Understanding this material is critical for both passing the CPA exam and applying these principles in real-world CFO scenarios.

CFO Application: As a CFO, you will regularly apply Definition of derivative concepts in financial reporting, strategic decision-making, and compliance with GAAP standards. This knowledge directly impacts your ability to prepare accurate financial statements and provide guidance to management.
CPA Exam Tip: Definition of derivative is frequently tested on the exam. Focus on practical application, authoritative guidance citations, and computational accuracy.

2. Fair value measurement

This topic covers essential CPA exam concepts related to Fair value measurement. Understanding this material is critical for both passing the CPA exam and applying these principles in real-world CFO scenarios.

CFO Application: As a CFO, you will regularly apply Fair value measurement concepts in financial reporting, strategic decision-making, and compliance with GAAP standards. This knowledge directly impacts your ability to prepare accurate financial statements and provide guidance to management.
CPA Exam Tip: Fair value measurement is frequently tested on the exam. Focus on practical application, authoritative guidance citations, and computational accuracy.

3. Gains/losses in earnings

This topic covers essential CPA exam concepts related to Gains/losses in earnings. Understanding this material is critical for both passing the CPA exam and applying these principles in real-world CFO scenarios.

CFO Application: As a CFO, you will regularly apply Gains/losses in earnings concepts in financial reporting, strategic decision-making, and compliance with GAAP standards. This knowledge directly impacts your ability to prepare accurate financial statements and provide guidance to management.
CPA Exam Tip: Gains/losses in earnings is frequently tested on the exam. Focus on practical application, authoritative guidance citations, and computational accuracy.

Practice Application

Work through practice problems applying week 1: derivative basics concepts. These problems mirror actual CPA exam scenarios and real-world CFO challenges.

Key Takeaways

  • Master Definition of derivative for exam success and professional competence
  • Master Fair value measurement for exam success and professional competence
  • Master Gains/losses in earnings for exam success and professional competence
  • Understand authoritative guidance and when to apply it
  • Practice computational problems until you can solve them efficiently
  • Connect concepts to real-world CFO responsibilities

weeks.title: Week 2: Cash Flow Hedges
weeks.lessonHtml:

weeks.title: Week 3: Fair Value Hedges
weeks.lessonHtml:

weeks.title: Week 4: Net Investment Hedges & Embedded Derivatives
weeks.lessonHtml:
Week 4: Net Investment Hedges & Embedded Derivatives

  • Identify and bifurcate embedded derivatives
  • Apply recent hedge accounting simplifications
